svg.text: One control plane (HQ), one multi-tenant commerce core, N independent brand storefronts. Access is decided by role scope, not by separate systems.
Cloudflare — DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS, bot management, image resizing, per-brand domains and TLS
Every brand domain (brandA.com, brandB.com …) resolves here; nothing reaches origin without passing the edge.
HQ view: all stores, warehouse, finance,
Storefronts talk only to the API edge below. Admin talks to the same APIs plus HQ-only endpoints; visibility is enforced server-side by OpenFGA, never hidden only in the UI.
Client analytics: PostHog SDK, Segment/RudderStack event tracking on every storefront and the admin.
auth check, rate limit, routing, request logs
scoped by store_id claim on every request
PSP, carriers, CMS publish, ERP sync
Row-level tenancy: every row carries store_id; PostgreSQL row-level security enforces it. Every state change emits a domain event to the bus below.
order.placed · payment.captured · refund.issued · shipment.created · stock.moved · customer.updated · product.published (schema registry, versioned, replayable)
HQ services — event consumers (only HQ roles can see these)
Flow: Postgres + events → ClickHouse (live) and warehouse (history) → dbt models: one per store, one consolidated → Metabase dashboards filtered by the viewer's store scope.
Build as a modular monolith first. Split out only what needs independent scaling: search indexer, accounting consumer, analytics ingest.
